Testing & Inspection: • Failed Inspection — An inspection result does not meet the approved acceptance requirements. • Failed Test Result — A test result is outside the specified acceptance criteria. • Required Test Not Performed — A mandatory test or inspection was not carried out. • Incorrect Test Method — The test or inspection method did not follow the approved procedure or standard. • Test Equipment / Calibration Issue — Test equipment was unsuitable, out of calibration or lacked valid certification. • Inspection Hold Point Bypassed — Work proceeded without the required inspection release or hold-point approval. Injury / Illness: • First Aid Case — A work-related injury or illness requiring basic first aid treatment. • Medical Treatment Case — A work-related injury or illness requiring treatment beyond basic first aid. • Lost Time Injury (LTI) — A work-related injury or illness resulting in lost time beyond the day or shift of the event. • Restricted Work Case — A work-related injury or illness resulting in temporary restriction from normal duties. • Occupational Illness — An illness suspected or confirmed to be related to workplace exposure or conditions. • Fatality — A work-related event resulting in death.
